title: Billing Team Worked-Example Sheet: Refill Bridge Blocks on Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Renewal Grants
content:
**Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, CGM supply allowance (HCPCS A4239).** The bridge adjustment adds blocks for a refill due while the grant still valid on the order date is in force, the next refill date being the latest refill's ship date plus its supply days less the tier's refill lead days and that grant's units left being the units the grants of the item authorized less the units of refills of the item, plus units of the item accepted back on returns: when that grant has no units left and the next refill date falls on or before its valid-through date, it adds the whole 30-day blocks from the next refill date through that valid-through date, both days counted; when it still has units left and the next refill date falls on or before its valid-through date, it adds those whole blocks less the units left, never below zero; otherwise it adds no blocks.

**Definitions used on this sheet.**

- *Units left*: the billing units all authorization grants of the item authorized, less the units of all refill shipments of the item, plus the units of the item accepted back on returns. No units left means that figure is zero or below.
- *Next refill date*: the latest refill's ship date plus its supply days, less the tier's refill ship lead days; with no refill of the item on record, the next refill date is the order date less the lead days.
- *Whole 30-day blocks*: complete blocks of 30 days, a remainder of fewer than 30 days adding no block.

| Tier | Refill ship lead days |
|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 7 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 7 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 10 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 10 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 10 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 7 |

**Outcomes.**

| Grant still valid on the order date | Next refill date on or before that grant's valid-through date | Units left | Blocks added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | none (zero or below) | the whole blocks from the next refill date through the valid-through date |
| yes | yes | above zero | those whole blocks less the units left, never below zero |
| yes | no (after the valid-through date) | any | none |
| no | any | any | none |

A next refill date falling on the grant's valid-through date itself is on or before it; one falling on the following day is not.

**Worked examples (hypothetical dates and unit figures, CGM Original Medicare Program lead days of 10).** A renewal order is dated 10 April of a hypothetical Year 1. The latest refill of the item shipped on 1 March of Year 1 with 90 days of supply, so its supply ends on 30 May and the next refill date is 20 May of Year 1.

1. A grant valid through 30 June of Year 1, no units left: 20 May through 30 June, both counted, is 42 days, 1 whole block. One block is added.
2. A grant valid through 31 July of Year 1, 1 unit left: 20 May through 31 July is 73 days, 2 whole blocks; 2 less 1 adds 1 block.
3. The same grant with 3 units left: 2 less 3 is below zero, so no block is added.
4. A grant valid through 15 May of Year 1: the next refill date of 20 May falls after it, so no block is added.
